subject: general
question: Which of the following measures can be adopted by the government to reduce revenue deficit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tax reforms**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tax reforms** are crucial measures that can help the government reduce revenue deficits.
 
• By implementing effective tax reforms, the government can increase its revenue without necessarily increasing tax rates.
 
• Tax reforms can include broadening the tax base, improving tax compliance, and reducing tax evasion.
 
• Improved tax administration and the introduction of modern technology in tax collection processes can also contribute significantly to reducing revenue deficits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Offering freebies and increasing subsidies may lead to higher government expenditure, potentially worsening the revenue deficit.
 
• Increasing money supply can lead to inflationary pressures and is not a sustainable solution for revenue deficits.
 
• Effective tax reforms can make the tax system more efficient and equitable, thus boosting government revenue without imposing undue burdens on taxpayers.
 
• Governments around the world have successfully reduced revenue deficits through comprehensive tax reforms.
